Thank you,
Carolina

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error message - I can´t open my analysis
parts:
To the list for info

We have now resolved that this issue was down to a shared .ocx file not being registered properly. It is not a reproducible issue but one that seems to occur occasionally with a variety of software applications and is probably related to some software update / uninstall.

Although not a Distance specific issue I have logged it in our bugs database with steps to resolve the issue should anyone else encounter it. https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/distance-bugs/issues/195

Thanks for getting in touch Chloe.

Best wishes,

Laura

Centre for Research into Ecological & Environmental Modelling
